prompt:

The large screen is not flat, but a curved giant LED screen that wraps around 90 degrees to the rounded corner of the building. Realistically express LED emission, pixel feel, and reflections.

Inside the screen, it's not a night view, but a bright high-end fashion advertising studio background of white, light gray, and pale gold. From there, a beautiful 22-year-old adult female fashion model pops out into reality in a bust-up shot only. Only the face, shoulders, chest, one arm, and one hand are visible; the waist, legs, feet, and lower body are not drawn. Red high-end designer outfit, satin or silk texture, sophisticated makeup, long hair, and a confident expression.

One hand is stretched out toward the viewer, expressing depth, shadows, and reflections like an anamorphic 3D advertisement. Neon and large screen lights reflect on the wet road, and passersby are looking up from a small perspective. No text or logos, no distortion of face or fingers.
